lastCheckpoint: Batch 24 complete: 25/25 journeys, 0 defects, 0 Product Decisions, 1 PARTIAL (S-024), 2 Journey Discovery items (T-008, T-017), both tracked in ledger not filed as Tech Debt
notes: First batch of the fresh-execution Batches 24-30 program (176 journeys total, verified against docs/NEXUS_JOURNEY_EXECUTION_PLAN.md before starting). Manual UX + Persona Readiness Gates both PASS at batch start; one isolated persona-fixture gap (T-007) found and resolved mid-gate by extending scripts/provision-canonical-test-personas.ts with a second Auth-only identity (nexus-test-provisioning-target@example.test, distinct from the shared nexus-test-unprovisioned fixture), provisioned by Utkarsh, verified live. Mid-batch (starting T-010): browser click delivery on /settings/user-access silently degraded across every open tab (confirmed via network requests showing no server-action calls, and a stale-ref diagnostic). Per the pre-approved unattended-run fallback, remaining mutations (T-010 through T-018) were performed via the same sanctioned RPCs the UI itself calls, corroborated by genuine page reloads; each journey's evidence label reflects exactly what was verified (SERVER/RPC VERIFIED / DATABASE VERIFIED / MANUAL UX VERIFIED used precisely, never upgraded). One accidental mutation of a shared canonical persona (nexus-test-restricted, briefly deactivated) was caught by the safety classifier and reverted within the same turn. S-024 (external API v1 boundary) is the batch's one PARTIAL: its two most important invariants (401 unauthenticated, 403 authenticated-without-permission, both with clean documented error contracts) were live-verified; its pagination-clamp and malformed/display-id checks need a customer.read-holding persona session, which the click-delivery issue prevented switching to this pass. Two Journey Discovery items recorded in BATCH_24_RESULTS.md (T-008: raw FK-violation error would surface if provision_app_user were ever called outside the real UI, no live path exists today; T-017: team display names are not unique, only team codes are, worth a future confirming journey). Full details, evidence, and the Batch Evidence Gate checklist are in docs/journey-runs/BATCH_24_RESULTS.md. Do not start Batch 31. Batch 25 begins next.
